content: <thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 127.0997, which in positive‑mode ESI is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂NO has an exact monoisotopic mass of 126.0919 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental error. No other reasonable combination of C, H, O, and a single heteroatom fits as well. Therefore the molecular formula is C₇H₁₂NO.
